description.purpose: A plain agent in hive form, the way agents are commonly built: a system prompt and messages, native tool calling, results as `tool_result`, a loop until the model stops (capped at `max_iter` 16). Its own tools come from a tools hive (bash, file, edit, web_fetch, web_search, weather); the caller adds client tools per turn, which leave the hive as `calls` and come back as `tool_result` inside the same turn. Identity and relationships live in its own affinity hive; a curator, a memory hive and the sidecar work as in talky/cogny. Sealed, with its own `./access` and vault grants and the `in_model` door. Since 1.0.1 (#1292) the template pins `memory-hive@3.16.6`; it is the third digit. Since 1.1.0 (#1292) the template carries this change and pins `collector@5.4.0`; it is the second digit.
description.use_when: One instance per agent: as the brain of a figure in a world, as a worker behind any caller that speaks the turn door, or alone.
description.not_in_scope: No world, no game day, no phone, no companion, no member, no build pair, no orga hive: a caller that needs one wraps the agent and speaks its turn door.
examples: turn -> brain -> weather -> file -> brain -> answer (three model calls, one answer)
turn with tools[] -> brain calls a client tool -> calls on the rim -> tool_result -> the same turn goes on -> answer

model.because: the model the one brain infers with -- a RESOLVED literal
